claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Spiroxatrine is a 5-HT1A/alpha1-adrenergic antagonist with no DNA-damaging or tubulin/microtubule activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, with any killing reflecting weak, non-selective pharmacology rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
